prose: antirez announces redis.antirez.com, a documentation site aimed at LLMs and coding agents working with Redis: exhaustive command and data-type docs, commonly used patterns, configuration hints, and algorithms that can be assembled from Redis commands. He adds that humans reportedly find it useful too - and that he's posting the link mainly so search engines index it.
highlights: redis.antirez.com: Redis documentation written for LLMs and coding agents
Covers commands, data types, patterns, config hints and composable algorithms
'Some humans claim this documentation is actually useful for actual people'
Posted explicitly so search engines index it
